compute.basis: No code released; must reimplement HRED-based HSCJN (GRU 500/1000, LSTM 500, 25K vocab, batch 8, beam 5) and train on 10,712 DailyDialog conversations, which is a multi-hour to multi-day CPU training run.

blockers: Requires reimplementing HRED + prediction network + max-entropy regularizer from scratch
Training on 10k dialogues with 500-1000 dim RNNs is slow on CPU
title: HSCJN: A Holistic Semantic Constraint Joint Network for Diverse Response Generation
